description.value: Pre-Cinder locks were built to a standard nobody makes replacement parts for anymore, which you've turned into an advantage. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Pick a Lock on any lock manufactured before the Turning.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +2 is conditioned on the lock's in-world manufacture date ('before the Turning'), a lore fact with no item trait or roll option representing it anywhere in this corpus or the base engine.
